很.pinyin: Wǒ hěn kuài jiù huì huí lai

很.zh: 这种款式的帽子现在很流行。
很.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng kuǎn shì de mào zi xiàn zài hěn liú xíng
很.en: This style of hat is now in fashion.
很.es: Este estilo de sombrero está ahora de moda.

月.zh: 她一个月写一次信给我。
月.pinyin: Tā yī ge yuè xiě yī cì xìn gěi wǒ
月.en: She writes to me once a month.
月.es: Ella me escribe una vez al mes.

月.pinyin: Nǐ de shēng rì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào
Yī nián yǒu shí èr gè yuè

月.zh: 自从他离开去法国，已经有两个月了。
月.pinyin: Zì cóng tā lí kāi qù fǎ guó yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng gè yuè le
月.en: Two months have passed since he left for France.
月.es: Han pasado dos meses desde que se fue a Francia.

又.zh: 我还了从图书馆借的书，又借了些新的。
又.pinyin: Wǒ hái le cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de shū yòu jiè le xiē xīn de
又.en: I returned the books I borrowed from the library, and I borrowed some new ones.
又.es: Devolví los libros que había sacado de la biblioteca y me llevé prestados otros nuevos.

又.pinyin: Tā de fáng zi yòu xiǎo yòu jiù
又.en: His house was small and old.
又.es: Su casa es pequeña y vieja.

又.pinyin: Míng tiān huì bù huì yòu hěn rè
又.en: Will it be hot again tomorrow?

又.zh: 他又高又胖，还总是很忙。
又.pinyin: Tā yòu gāo yòu pàng hái zǒng shì hěn máng
又.en: He is tall, fat and always busy.
又.es: Es alto y gordo, y siempre está ocupado.

先.zh: 好的，但我们先吃晚饭吧。
先.pinyin: Hǎo de dàn wǒ men xiān chī wǎn fàn ba
先.en: Sure, but let's eat dinner first.
先.es: Vale, pero vamos a cenar primero.

先.zh: 你想我们先结婚还是先生孩子？
先.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng wǒ men xiān jié hūn hái shi xiān sheng hái zi
先.en: Do you want to get married first or have a child first?
先.es: ¿Quieres casarte primero o tener un hijo primero?

先.zh: 你想去美国读书的话，一定要先申请一张学生签证。
先.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù měi guó dú shū de huà yī dìng yào xiān shēn qǐng yī zhāng xué sheng qiān zhèng
先.en: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
先.es: Si quieres estudiar en Estados Unidos, necesitas conseguir una visa de estudiante.

先.zh: 你要先输入好个人资料，然后才能买票。
先.pinyin: Nǐ yào xiān shū rù hǎo gè rén zī liào rán hòu cái néng mǎi piào
先.en: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
先.es: Para comprar una entrada, hay que entrar tus detalles personales.

明白.pinyin: Wǒ míng bai nǐ de gǎn shòu

明白.zh: 我明白你为甚么不想去了。
明白.pinyin: Wǒ míng bai nǐ wèi shèn má bù xiǎng qù le
明白.en: I see why you don't want to go there.
明白.es: Ya veo por qué no quieres ir ahí.

明白.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài míng bai tā shuō shén me
明白.en: I don't quite understand what he says.
明白.es: No entiendo muy bien lo que dice.

明白.pinyin: Zǒng yǒu yī tiān nǐ huì míng bai de
明白.en: You will understand it as time passes.

啤酒.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài lái yī bēi pí jiǔ
Nà shí hou wǒ bù xǐ huan pí jiǔ
啤酒.en: I didn't like beer at that time.
啤酒.es: Entonces no me gustaba la cerveza.

啤酒.zh: 我去和朋友喝了杯啤酒。
啤酒.pinyin: Wǒ qù hé péng you hē le bēi pí jiǔ
啤酒.en: I went to drink a beer with friends.
啤酒.es: Fui a beber una cerveza con los amigos.

啤酒.pinyin: Pí jiǔ píng shì bō li zuò de
啤酒.en: Beer bottles are made of glass.
啤酒.es: Las botellas de cerveza están hechas de vidrio.

办法.zh: 你到底是用了什么办法在短期内提高了你的汉语？
办法.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ shì yòng le shén me bàn fǎ zài duǎn qī nèi tí gāo le nǐ de hàn yǔ
办法.en: Exactly what method did you use to improve your Mandarin in such a short space of time?
办法.es: ¿Exactamente qué método usaste para mejorar tanto tu mandarín en tan poco tiempo?

办法.zh: 这个问题不能用普通的办法解决。
办法.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí bù néng yòng pǔ tōng de bàn fǎ jiě jué
办法.en: You cannot solve this problem in an ordinary way.
办法.es: No puedes resolver este problema de forma normal.

办法.zh: 对我来说，努力学习就是最好取得成功的办法。
办法.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō nǔ lì xué xí jiù shì zuì hǎo qǔ dé chéng gōng de bàn fǎ
办法.en: In my view, studying hard is the best way to achieve success.

美丽.pinyin: Nǐ shì duō me de měi lì

美丽.zh: 这是我见过最美丽的景色。
美丽.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ jiàn guo zuì měi lì de jǐng sè
美丽.en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
美丽.es: Este es el mejor panorama que he visto jamás.

美丽.pinyin: Shēng mìng shì měi lì de
Rì běn shì gè měi lì de guó jiā

谈.pinyin: Nǐ men tán le shén me

谈.zh: 不谈了！我们去周庄玩怎么样？
谈.pinyin: Bù tán le wǒ men qù zhōu zhuāng wán zěn me yàng
谈.en: No need to say anything more. How about we go to Zhouzhuang?

谈.zh: 我没有任何可以谈这件事的朋友。
谈.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu rèn hé kě yǐ tán zhè jiàn shì de péng you
谈.en: I have no friend with whom to talk about it.

作家.zh: 我怀疑我是不是一个好作家。
作家.pinyin: Wǒ huái yí wǒ shì bu shì yī ge hǎo zuò jiā
作家.en: I doubt that I'm a good writer.

作家.zh: 我觉得他是一个优秀的作家。
作家.pinyin: Wǒ jué de tā shì yī ge yōu xiù de zuò jiā
作家.en: I consider him a great writer.

作家.zh: 那个意大利作家在日本不太出名。
作家.pinyin: Nà ge yì dà lì zuò jiā zài rì běn bù tài chū míng
作家.en: That Italian author is little known in Japan.
作家.es: Ese autor italiano no es muy conocido en Japón.

作家.pinyin: Nà ge zuò jiā zhèng zài xiě xīn shū
作家.en: The writer is working on a new book.
作家.es: Ese escritor está escribiendo un nuevo libro.

丰富.zh: 印度是一个烹饪文化丰富的地区。
丰富.pinyin: Yìn dù shì yī ge pēng rèn wén huà fēng fù de dì qū
丰富.en: India is a region rich in culinary culture.
丰富.es: La India es una región rica en cultura culinaria.

丰富.zh: 日本并不拥有丰富的自然资源。
丰富.pinyin: Rì běn bìng bù yōng yǒu fēng fù de zì rán zī yuán
丰富.en: Japan is not rich in natural resources.
丰富.es: Japón no es rico en recursos naturales.

丰富.zh: 那个国家拥有丰富的矿物资源。
丰富.pinyin: Nà ge guó jiā yōng yǒu fēng fù de kuàng wù zī yuán
丰富.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.
丰富.es: Ese país es rico en recursos naturales.

丰富.zh: 美国的自然资源很丰富。
丰富.pinyin: Měi guó de zì rán zī yuán hěn fēng fù
丰富.en: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
丰富.es: Estados Unidos es abundante en recursos naturales.

密码.zh: 我们毫不费力地想出了密码。
密码.pinyin: Wǒ men háo bù fèi lì de xiǎng chū le mì mǎ
密码.en: We easily figured out the password.

密码.zh: 当且仅当你知道我们的密码你才可以进来。
密码.pinyin: Dāng qiě jǐn dāng nǐ zhī dào wǒ men de mì mǎ nǐ cái kě yǐ jìn lái
密码.en: You can come in if and only if you know our password.
密码.es: Puedes entrar solamente si conoces nuestra contraseña.

密码.zh: 你该选择个安全的密码。
密码.pinyin: Nǐ gāi xuǎn zé gè ān quán de mì mǎ
密码.en: You should choose a strong password!

密码.zh: 在这个密码里，每个数字取代了一个字母。
密码.pinyin: Zài zhè ge mì mǎ lǐ měi ge shù zì qǔ dài le yī ge zì mǔ
密码.en: In this secret code, each number stands for a letter of the alphabet.
密码.es: En este código secreto, cada número representa a una letra del alfabeto.

演出.pinyin: Yǎn chū shén me shí hou kāi shǐ
演出.en: What time does the play begin?

演出.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān qù kàn yǎn chū le
演出.en: I went to see a show today.

演出.zh: 那是一个给我们带来无穷乐趣的传奇性的演出。
演出.pinyin: Nà shi yī ge gěi wǒ men dài lái wú qióng lè qù de chuán qí xìng de yǎn chū
演出.en: It was a fabulous show which brought us an endless delight.

演出.zh: 演出真的很有意思，你该去看看的。
演出.pinyin: Yǎn chū zhēn de hěn yǒu yì si nǐ gāi qù kàn kan de
演出.en: The show was very interesting. You should have seen it.

普遍.zh: 我们国家的年轻人对政治普遍不感兴趣。
普遍.pinyin: Wǒ men guó jiā de nián qīng rén duì zhèng zhì pǔ biàn bù gǎn xìng qù
普遍.en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
普遍.es: La juventud de nuestro país no se interesa por la política.

普遍.zh: 人们普遍认为吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。
普遍.pinyin: Rén men pǔ biàn rèn wéi chī de kǔ zhōng kǔ fāng wéi rén shàng rén
普遍.en: It is generally accepted that a person cannot be successful in life without a lot of hard work.
普遍.es: Es algo aceptado de forma general que no se puede ser exitoso en la vida sin mucho trabajo duro.

普遍.zh: 夫妻分担家务的情况愈来愈普遍。
普遍.pinyin: Fū qī fēn dān jiā wù de qíng kuàng yù lái yù pǔ biàn
普遍.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
普遍.es: Cada vez más parejas casadas comparten las tareas del hogar.

普遍.zh: 普遍认为佛教公元六七年在东汉明帝的统治时先来中国。
普遍.pinyin: Pǔ biàn rèn wéi fó jiào gōng yuán liù qī nián zài dōng hàn míng dì de tǒng zhì shí xiān lái zhōng guó
普遍.en: It is generally believed that Buddhism first came to China in 67 A.D. during the reign of Emperor Mingdi of the Eastern Han Dynasty.
普遍.es: Es una creencia generalizada que el budismo llegó por primera vez a China en el 67 d. C. durante el reinado del Emperador Ming de la dinastía Han Oriental.

整个.zh: 百合的香气充满了整个房间。
整个.pinyin: Bǎi hé de xiāng qì chōng mǎn le zhěng gè fáng jiān
整个.en: A smell of lilies filled the room.
整个.es: Una fragancia a lirios colmaba la habitación.

整个.zh: 整个小区对这个消息很惊讶。
整个.pinyin: Zhěng gè xiǎo qū duì zhè ge xiāo xi hěn jīng yà
整个.en: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
整个.es: El vecindario entero se sorprendió por la noticia.

整个.zh: 这场战役让拿破仑称霸了整个欧洲。
整个.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhàn yì ràng ná pò lún chēng bà le zhěng gè ōu zhōu
整个.en: This battle left Napoleon master of Europe.
整个.es: Esta batalla puso a Napoleón al mando de Europa.

整个.zh: 我们成了整个村庄的笑柄。
整个.pinyin: Wǒ men chéng le zhěng gè cūn zhuāng de xiào bǐng
整个.en: We've become a mockery to the whole village.

年纪.zh: 明年我的年纪会是你的三倍。
年纪.pinyin: Míng nián wǒ de nián jì huì shì nǐ de sān bèi
年纪.en: Next year I will be three times as old as you.
年纪.es: El año que viene tendré tres veces tu edad.

年纪.zh: 我在你这个年纪的时候，冥王星是一颗行星。
年纪.pinyin: Wǒ zài nǐ zhè ge nián jì de shí hou míng wáng xīng shì yī kē xíng xīng
年纪.en: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
年纪.es: Cuando yo tenía tu edad, Plutón era un planeta.

年纪.zh: 你跟他在你这个年纪时一样努力工作。
年纪.pinyin: Nǐ gēn tā zài nǐ zhè ge nián jì shí yī yàng nǔ lì gōng zuò
年纪.en: You work as hard as he did at your age.
年纪.es: Trabajas tan duro como él lo hacía a tu edad.

年纪.zh: 你现在这个年纪，穿成这个样子，会给人取笑的。
年纪.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài zhè ge nián jì chuān chéng zhè ge yàng zi huì gěi rén qǔ xiào de
年纪.en: If you dress like that at your age, you'll make a fool of yourself.
年纪.es: Vistiéndote así a tu edad vas a hacer el ridículo.

目前.pinyin: Mù qián wǒ dāi zài jiǔ diàn
目前.en: For now, I will wait at the hotel.
目前.es: Por el momento me quedo en el hotel.

目前.zh: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。
目前.pinyin: Tā hé tā dī jiě mèi men mù qián dōu zhù zài dōng jīng
目前.en: His sisters as well as he are now living in Tokyo.
目前.es: En este momento él y sus hermanas viven en Tokio.

目前.pinyin: Zhè xiē jī qì mù qián bù yùn zhuǎn

目前.zh: 目前我的邮件有点问题。
目前.pinyin: Mù qián wǒ de yóu jiàn yǒu diǎn wèn tí
目前.en: I'm having problems with e-mail right now.

表现.pinyin: Tā zài xué xiào de biǎo xiàn hěn hǎo
表现.en: He is doing very well at school.
表现.es: Le está yendo muy bien en el colegio.

表现.pinyin: Tā biǎo xiàn de xiàng gè fēng zi

表现.zh: 两组在比赛中的表现都不太好。
表现.pinyin: Liǎng zǔ zài bǐ sài zhòng dì biǎo xiàn dōu bù tài hǎo
表现.en: Neither team played well in the game.
表现.es: Ningún equipo jugó bien en el partido.

表现.zh: 孩子想和大人一样表现。
表现.pinyin: Hái zi xiǎng hé dà ren yī yàng biǎo xiàn
表现.en: Children want to act like grown-ups.
表现.es: Los niños quieren actuar como adultos.

推荐.zh: 我可以向你推荐这本书。
推荐.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ xiàng nǐ tuī jiàn zhè běn shū
推荐.en: I can recommend this book to you.

推荐.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shén me tuī jiàn
推荐.en: What do you recommend to me?

推荐.zh: 汤姆向他们推荐了那本小说。
推荐.pinyin: Tāng mǔ xiàng tā men tuī jiàn le nà běn xiǎo shuō
推荐.en: Tom recommended the novel to them.

推荐.zh: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
推荐.pinyin: Wǒ bù tuī jiàn zài nà jiā cān guǎn chī fàn shí wù zāo gāo tòu le
推荐.en: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
推荐.es: Yo no recomiendo comer en este restaurante. La comida es horrible.

智慧.zh: 你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。
智慧.pinyin: Nǐ de zhì huì guǎng dà de yǒu rú mèng mǎi hé mèng mǎi zhī jiān de jù lí
智慧.en: Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
智慧.es: Tu inteligencia es tan extensa como la distancia entre Bombay y Mumbai.

智慧.zh: 即使他有些小聪明，但是他并不智慧。
智慧.pinyin: Jí shǐ tā yǒu xiē xiǎo cōng ming dàn shì tā bìng bù zhì huì
智慧.en: Though he is clever, he isn't wise.
智慧.es: Aunque es listo no es sabio.

智慧.pinyin: Tā de zhì huì fēi fán
智慧.en: He is remarkable for his wisdom.

智慧.zh: 做该做的事是智慧，做不该做的事是愚痴。
智慧.pinyin: Zuò gāi zuò de shì shì zhì huì zuò bù gāi zuò de shì shì yú chī
智慧.en: Intelligence is doing what you are supposed to, while stupidity is doing what you are not supposed to.

圈.zh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
圈.pinyin: Tā yòng qiān bǐ zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī ge quān
圈.en: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
圈.es: Ella dibujó un círculo con un lápiz en un trozo de papel.

圈.zh: 光一秒钟能够环绕地球七圈半。
圈.pinyin: Guāng yī miǎo zhōng néng gòu huán rào dì qiú qī quān bàn
圈.en: Light travels around the earth seven and a half times a second.
圈.es: La luz da una vuelta alrededor de la Tierra siete veces y media por segundo.

圈.pinyin: Nǐ de míng zi zěn me quān le

论文.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。
论文.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo kě yǐ bāng wǒ xiū gǎi zhè piān lùn wén de mǔ yǔ rén shì
论文.en: I am looking for a native speaker who can correct this paper for me.
论文.es: Estoy buscando a un hablante nativo que me pueda ayudar a corregir este ensayo.

论文.zh: 他的论文总结了电脑，人造卫星和火箭三个的新成就。
论文.pinyin: Tā de lùn wén zǒng jié le diàn nǎo rén zào wèi xīng hé huǒ jiàn sān gè de xīn chéng jiù
论文.en: His thesis summed up the new achievements made in computers, artificial satellites and rockets.
论文.es: Su tesis sintetiza los nuevos logros conseguidos en cuanto a ordenadores, satélites artificiales y cohetes espaciales.

论文.zh: 要翻译那篇论文，我最少需要三天时间。
论文.pinyin: Yào fān yì nà piān lùn wén wǒ zuì shǎo xū yào sān tiān shí jiān
论文.en: I'll need at least three days to translate that thesis.
论文.es: Necesitaré al menos tres días para traducir esa tesis.

论文.zh: 我最近真忙于我的毕业论文。
论文.pinyin: Wǒ zuì jìn zhēn máng yú wǒ de bì yè lùn wén
论文.en: I've been really busy with my graduation dissertation recently.

商品.zh: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
商品.pinyin: Dà liàng shēng chǎn jiàng dī xǔ duō shāng pǐn de jià gé
商品.en: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
商品.es: La producción en masa redujo el precio de muchos productos.

商品.zh: 你可以来提货，我们也可以把商品送到您那里。
商品.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ lái tí huò wǒ men yě kě yǐ bǎ shāng pǐn sòng dào nín nà li
商品.en: You can come pick up the goods, or we can bring them to you.

商品.zh: 那商店里的商品全都打九折呢。
商品.pinyin: Nà shāng diàn lǐ de shāng pǐn quán dōu dá jiǔ zhé ne
商品.en: Everything at that store is 10 percent off the regular price.

商品.pinyin: Zhè ge shāng pǐn yǐ shòu qìng
商品.en: This product is already sold out.

成果.pinyin: Tā de nǔ lì méi yǒu chéng guǒ
成果.en: Nothing has resulted from his efforts.
成果.es: Sus esfuerzos no dieron ningún resultado.

成果.pinyin: Wǒ men méi qǔ dé shén me chéng guǒ

成果.zh: 这发明是多年来耐心实验的成果。
成果.pinyin: Zhè fā míng shì duō nián lái nài xīn shí yàn de chéng guǒ
成果.en: This invention was the result of years of patient experiment.
成果.es: Este invento es el resultado de muchos años de paciente experimentación.

成果.zh: 他对自己的劳动成果很满意。
成果.pinyin: Tā duì zì jǐ de láo dòng chéng guǒ hěn mǎn yì
成果.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.
成果.es: Estaba satisfecho con el trabajo que había realizado.

游览.zh: 我的爱好是游览古老的庙宇。
游览.pinyin: Wǒ de ài hào shì yóu lǎn gǔ lǎo de miào yǔ
游览.en: My hobby is visiting old temples.
游览.es: Mi pasatiempo es visitar templos antiguos.

游览.zh: 我们的音乐老师建议我去游览维也纳。
游览.pinyin: Wǒ men de yīn yuè lǎo shī jiàn yì wǒ qù yóu lǎn wéi yě nà
游览.en: Our music teacher advised me to visit Vienna.
游览.es: Nuestro profesor de música me aconsejó visitar Viena.

游览.zh: 我游览了英国许多地方。
游览.pinyin: Wǒ yóu lǎn le yīng guó xǔ duō dì fang
游览.en: I visited many parts of England.

游览.pinyin: Jīng dū zhí de yóu lǎn

实践.zh: 我们怎样才能将其付出实践？
实践.pinyin: Wǒ men zěn yàng cái néng jiāng qí fù chū shí jiàn
实践.en: How can we put it into practice?

实践.zh: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
实践.pinyin: Lǐ lùn shàng shuō lǐ lùn hé shí jiàn méi yǒu qū bié dàn shí jiàn shàng shuō shì yǒu de
实践.en: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
实践.es: En teoría, no hay ninguna diferencia entre la teoría y la práctica. Pero en la práctica sí.

实践.zh: 她作为一个喜欢动手实践的人常常把朋友的汽车修好。
实践.pinyin: Tā zuò wéi yī ge xǐ huan dòng shǒu shí jiàn de rén cháng cháng bǎ péng you de qì chē xiū hǎo
实践.en: As she's a very practical person, she often fixes her friends' cars.

实践.zh: 把想法付诸实践是困难的。
实践.pinyin: Bǎ xiǎng fǎ fù zhū shí jiàn shì kùn nan de
实践.en: Putting ideas into practice is difficult.

哈.zh: ”哈亚斯坦“是亚美尼亚的名字在亚美尼亚语中。
哈.pinyin: Hā yà sī tǎn shì yà měi ní yà de míng zi zài yà měi ní yà yǔ zhōng
哈.es: "Hayastan" es el nombre de Armenia en armenio.

哈.zh: 亚美尼亚在亚美尼亚语中是”哈亚斯坦“。
哈.pinyin: Yà měi ní yà zài yà měi ní yà yǔ zhōng shì hā yà sī tǎn
Niǔ yuē wèi zài hā de xùn hé
哈.en: New York is on the Hudson River.
哈.es: Nueva York se encuentra sobre el río Hudson.

预订.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēng gǎi wǒ de yù dìng
预订.en: I'd like to change my reservation.

预订.zh: 我取消了我旅馆的预订。
预订.pinyin: Wǒ qǔ xiāo le wǒ lǚ guǎn de yù dìng
预订.es: Cancelé mi reserva en el hotel.

Wǒ xiǎng yù dìng yī jiān dān rén fáng
预订.en: I'd like to reserve a single room.

参考.zh: 我也不喜欢谷歌翻译，但是我经常会使用它作为参考。
参考.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù xǐ huan gǔ gē fān yì dàn shì wǒ jīng cháng huì shǐ yòng tā zuò wéi cān kǎo
参考.en: I don't like Google Translate either, but I always use it for reference.

参考.zh: 佩蓉，你那份报告可以借我参考一下吗？
参考.pinyin: Pèi róng nǐ nà fèn bào gào kě yǐ jiè wǒ cān kǎo yī xià ma
参考.en: Pei-rong, can I take a look at your report for reference?

参考.zh: 不留名或详细的参考什么都可以。
参考.pinyin: Bù liú míng huò xiáng xì de cān kǎo shén me dōu kě yǐ
参考.en: Anonymity or detailed reference are both fine.

参考.zh: 我会将这则资讯记下来，以便未来参考。
参考.pinyin: Wǒ huì jiāng zhè zé zī xùn jì xià lai yǐ biàn wèi lái cān kǎo
参考.en: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.

传说.zh: 传说彭祖是天帝的孙子。
传说.pinyin: Chuán shuō péng zǔ shì tiān dì de sūn zǐ
传说.en: It is said that Peng Zu was the grandson of a celestial emperor.

传说.zh: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。
传说.pinyin: Shén huà hé chuán shuō yīng gāi yī dài yī dài de chuán chéng xià qù
传说.en: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.

周到.zh: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
周到.pinyin: Nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men
周到.en: You were considerate not to disturb us.

周到.zh: 你不能指望我一直考虑周到！
周到.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng zhǐ wàng wǒ yī zhí kǎo lǜ zhōu dào
周到.en: You can't expect me to always think of everything!
周到.es: ¡No puedes esperar de mí que yo siempre piense en todo!

周到.pinyin: Tā fēi cháng zhōu dào hé nài xīn
周到.en: She is very thoughtful and patient.
周到.es: Ella es muy considerada y paciente.

果然.zh: 我对他的第一印象果然没有错。
果然.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā de dì yī yìn xiàng guǒ rán méi yǒu cuò
果然.en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
果然.es: Mi primera impresión acerca de él resultó ser correcta.

果然.zh: 我们昨天试了一下，果然是很好。
果然.pinyin: Wǒ men zuó tiān shì le yī xià guǒ rán shì hěn hǎo
果然.en: We tried it out yesterday; as expected, it was really good.

迈.pinyin: Zhè shì mài kè de zì xíng chē
迈.es: Esta es la bicicleta de Mike.

疾病.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。

疾病.en: No medicine can cure this disease.
疾病.es: Ningún remedio puede curar esta enfermedad.

疾病.zh: 这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。
疾病.pinyin: Zhè xiē cuò shī kě yǐ yù fáng jí bìng màn yán
疾病.en: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.
疾病.es: Estas medidas pueden impedir la propagación de la enfermedad.

疾病.pinyin: Wū huì dǎo zhì jí bìng

疾病.zh: 我今天有点不舒服。那户井水是许多疾病的源头。
疾病.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān yǒu diǎn bù shū fu nà hù jǐng shuǐ shì xǔ duō jí bìng de yuán tóu
疾病.en: I don't feel well today. That well water is the cause of many illnesses.

时光.pinyin: Wǒ dù guò le měi hǎo de shí guāng
时光.es: Me lo he pasado muy bien.

时光.zh: 我在派对上度过了一段快乐的时光。
时光.pinyin: Wǒ zài pài duì shàng dù guò le yī duàn kuài lè de shí guāng
时光.en: I had a good time at the party.
时光.es: La pasé bien en la fiesta.

时光.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。
时光.pinyin: Nà shi wǒ yī shēng zhōng zuì měi hǎo de shí guāng zhī yī
时光.en: That is one of my best time in my life.

愈.zh: 问题愈难，我懂得回答的机会就愈低。
愈.pinyin: Wèn tí yù nán wǒ dǒng de huí dá de jī huì jiù yù dī
愈.en: The more difficult the questions are, the less likely I'll be able to answer them.
愈.es: Cuanto más difíciles son las preguntas, menos probablemente seré capaz de responderlas.

愈.zh: 我们登得愈高，空气就愈稀薄。
愈.pinyin: Wǒ men dēng de yù gāo kōng qì jiù yù xī bó
愈.en: The higher we go up, the thinner the air becomes.
愈.es: Mientras más alto subimos, el aire se vuelve menos denso.

愈.zh: 认识的人愈多，见面的时间就愈少。
愈.pinyin: Rèn shi de rén yù duō jiàn miàn de shí jiān jiù yù shǎo
愈.en: The more people you know, the less time you have to see them.

愈.zh: 对爱掩饰得越多，愈是证明你喜欢他。
愈.pinyin: Duì ài yǎn shì de yuè duō yù shì zhèng míng nǐ xǐ huan tā
愈.en: The longer you hide your feelings for someone, the more you fall for them.

愤怒.zh: 即使他道歉了，我还是很愤怒。
愤怒.pinyin: Jí shǐ tā dào qiàn le wǒ hái shi hěn fèn nù
愤怒.en: Even though he apologized, I'm still furious.
愤怒.es: Aunque él se disculpó, aún estoy enojada.

愤怒.zh: 鲍勃无法控制他的愤怒。
愤怒.pinyin: Bào bó wú fǎ kòng zhì tā de fèn nù
愤怒.en: Bob could not control his anger.
愤怒.es: Bob no podía controlar su ira.

愤怒.zh: 无色的绿色意念愤怒地沉睡着。
愤怒.pinyin: Wú sè de lǜ sè yì niàn fèn nù de chén shuì zhe
愤怒.es: Ideas verdes sin color duermen furiosamente.

仪式.pinyin: Yí shì yǐ tā de jiǎng huà kāi shǐ
仪式.en: The ceremony began with his speech.
仪式.es: La ceremonia comenzó con su discurso.

仪式.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。
仪式.pinyin: Shù yǐ qiān jì de là zhú diǎn liàng le yí shì zhòng dì jiào táng
仪式.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
仪式.es: Miles de velas iluminaban la iglesia durante la ceremonia.

仪式.pinyin: Nǐ huì cān jiā zhè ge yí shì ma
仪式.en: Will you take part in the ceremony?

仪式.zh: 我上个月组织了一个结婚仪式。
仪式.pinyin: Wǒ shàng gè yuè zǔ zhī le yī ge jié hūn yí shì
仪式.en: I organized a marriage ceremony last month.

疲惫.zh: 我因为时差而感到疲惫。
疲惫.pinyin: Wǒ yīn wèi shí chā ér gǎn dào pí bèi
疲惫.en: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.
疲惫.es: Estoy cansado debido al desfase horario.

疲惫.zh: 这个女士看起来很悲伤，也很疲惫。
疲惫.pinyin: Zhè ge nǚ shì kàn qǐ lai hěn bēi shāng yě hěn pí bèi
疲惫.en: The lady looked sad, also tired.
疲惫.es: La señorita se veía triste, y cansada.

疲惫.zh: 菲利普不喜欢客场比赛，他总是容易感到很疲惫。
疲惫.pinyin: Fēi lì pǔ bù xǐ huan kè chǎng bǐ sài tā zǒng shì róng yì gǎn dào hěn pí bèi
疲惫.en: Philip hates traveling for away games. He always gets really tired and never plays well.

团结.zh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。
团结.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū tuán jié qǐ lai cái néng zhàn shèng dí rén
团结.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
团结.es: Debemos unirnos para derrotar al enemigo.

团结.zh: 团结、公正和自由是幸福的保证。
团结.pinyin: Tuán jié gōng zhèng hé zì yóu shì xìng fú de bǎo zhèng
团结.en: Unity, justice and freedom are the pledge of fortune.
团结.es: Unidad, justicia y libertad son la promesa de la fortuna.

团结.zh: 演出的成功，在于大家的团结努力。
团结.pinyin: Yǎn chū de chéng gōng zài yú dà jiā de tuán jié nǔ lì
团结.en: Everybody's hard work contributed to the show's success.

罪犯.zh: 美国的罪犯大多是吸毒成瘾的瘾君子。
罪犯.pinyin: Měi guó de zuì fàn dà duō shì xī dú chéng yǐn de yǐn jūn zǐ
罪犯.en: Many criminals in America are addicted to drugs.
罪犯.es: Muchos criminales en los Estados Unidos son adictos a las drogas.

罪犯.pinyin: Nà xiē rén shì zuì fàn ma
Jǐng fāng néng gòu zhǎo dào zuì fàn
罪犯.en: The police were able to find the criminal.
罪犯.es: La policía pudo encontrar al criminal.

罪犯.zh: 有一个危险的罪犯从监狱里逃了出来。
罪犯.pinyin: Yǒu yī ge wēi xiǎn de zuì fàn cóng jiān yù lǐ táo le chū lái
罪犯.en: A dangerous criminal escaped from prison.

团体.zh: 他试着统一不同的团体。
团体.pinyin: Tā shì zhe tǒng yī bù tóng de tuán tǐ
团体.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
团体.es: Él intentó unificar los distintos grupos.

团体.zh: 带孩子团体去图书馆一点问题都没有。
团体.pinyin: Dài hái zi tuán tǐ qù tú shū guǎn yī diǎn wèn tí dōu méi yǒu
团体.en: Taking the group of children to the library was no problem.
团体.es: No fue un problema llevar al grupo de niños a la biblioteca.

团体.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
团体.pinyin: Nà ge tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ
团体.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

团体.en: April is the national minority health month.

开除.zh: 如果那个男人再犯一个错误，我就开除他。
开除.pinyin: Rú guǒ nà ge nán rén zài fàn yī ge cuò wù wǒ jiù kāi chú tā
开除.en: If that man makes one more mistake, I'll fire him.
开除.es: Si ese hombre comete otro error, lo despediré.

开除.zh: 他们全部都应该被开除。
开除.pinyin: Tā men quán bù dōu yīng gāi bèi kāi chú
Wǒ men jué dìng bù kāi chú nǐ
开除.en: We've decided not to fire you.

开除.zh: 你要是照着汤姆告诉你的办法做，你有可能会被开除的。
开除.pinyin: Nǐ yào shi zhào zhe tāng mǔ gào su nǐ de bàn fǎ zuò nǐ yǒu kě néng huì bèi kāi chú de
开除.en: You might get fired if you do that the way Tom told you to.

修复.zh: 我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。
修复.pinyin: Wǒ hěn gāo xìng tā men xiū fù le nuǎn qì xì tǒng dàn xiàn zài tài rè le
修复.en: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
修复.es: Me alegro de que ellos hayan reparado la calefacción, pero ahora hace demasiado calor.

修复.zh: 这个坏掉的花瓶无法修复了。
修复.pinyin: Zhè ge huài diào de huā píng wú fǎ xiū fù le
修复.en: This broken vase can't be repaired.

修复.zh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。
修复.pinyin: Xì tǒng gù zhàng de xiū fù gōng zuò chí xù le yī zhěng gè wǎn shang
修复.en: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.

修复.zh: 一座历史地标已经修复并将重新开放。
修复.pinyin: Yī zuò lì shǐ dì biāo yǐ jīng xiū fù bìng jiāng chóng xīn kāi fàng
修复.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.

殖民地.zh: 肯尼亚曾经是英国的殖民地。
殖民地.pinyin: Kěn ní yà céng jīng shì yīng guó de zhí mín dì
殖民地.en: Kenya used to be a British colony.
殖民地.es: Kenia solía ser una colonia inglesa.

殖民地.zh: 尼日利亚曾经是英国的殖民地。
殖民地.pinyin: Ní rì lì yà céng jīng shì yīng guó de zhí mín dì
殖民地.en: At one time Nigeria was a British colony.
殖民地.es: Antiguamente, Nigeria era una colonia británica.

殖民地.zh: 有人说中国像是俄国的殖民地。
殖民地.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō zhòng guó xiàng shì é guó de zhí mín dì
殖民地.en: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.

殖民地.zh: 台湾曾经是日本的殖民地。
殖民地.pinyin: Tái wān céng jīng shì rì běn de zhí mín dì
殖民地.en: Taiwan was once a colony of Japan.

默默.zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。
默默.pinyin: Wǒ de mǔ qīn zhǐ shì mò mò de kū qì
默默.en: My mother did nothing but weep.
默默.es: Mi madre se limitó a llorar.

默默.pinyin: Tā mò mò de kàn zhe wǒ

默默.en: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.

固执.zh: 王小姐有一点固执，但是她还算是一个好学生。
固执.pinyin: Wáng xiǎo jie yǒu yī diǎn gù zhí dàn shì tā hái suàn shì yī ge hǎo xué shēng
固执.en: Miss Wang has a trace of obstinacy in her, but she is still a good student.
固执.es: La señorita Wang tiene un vestigio de obstinación en ella, pero aun así es una buena estudiante.

固执.pinyin: Tāng mǔ tǐng gù zhí de bù shì ma
固执.en: Tom is being quite obstinate, isn't he?

劈.zh: 你敢说那庙是个破庙...你不怕被雷劈了吗？
劈.pinyin: Nǐ gǎn shuō nà miào shì gè pò miào nǐ bù pà bèi léi pī le ma
劈.en: How dare you say that that temple is a ruined temple...aren't you afraid of being struck by lightning?

劈.pinyin: Luàn fā shì huì zāo léi pī de
劈.en: If you swear reckless oaths, lightning will strike you.

倔强.pinyin: Tā shì gè jué jiàng de nǚ hái
Tā shì gè jué jiàng de rén

倔强.pinyin: Shì shí shì jué jiàng de dàn tǒng jì shì róu shùn de

同胞.pinyin: Tā bù yuàn yì wèi tóng bāo zuò zhèng
同胞.en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.

提炼.zh: 油是从橄榄中提炼出来的。
提炼.pinyin: Yóu shì cóng gǎn lǎn zhōng tí liàn chū lái de
提炼.es: El aceite es extraído de las olivas.

无比.zh: 伤口发炎后，他感到难忍无比的剧痛。
无比.pinyin: Shāng kǒu fā yán hòu tā gǎn dào nán rěn wú bǐ de jù tòng
无比.en: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.

陶醉.pinyin: Tā táo zuì zài xìng fú lǐ

非法.en: I've never done anything illegal in my life.

非法.en: Many are able to enter the USA illegally.
